fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) stock has risen 452.7% since October 2021, yet revenue has grown only 20.2% in the same period, with net margin expansion (14.1%→31.9%) and PER increases as primary drivers.
fields.summary_ko.1: Recent net margin at a 10-year peak of 41.6% and PER declining from 68.2 (10-year high) to 24.6 indicate limited room for further margin expansion and multiple increases.
